proposal.summary: An access control issue in Wavlink WN533A8 M33A8.V5030.190716 allows attackers to obtain usernames and passwords by viewing the sysinit.shtml page source and searching for a logincheck(user) string.
proposal.cwe_quote: allows attackers to obtain usernames and passwords via view-source:http://IP_ADDRESS/sysinit.shtml?r=52300 and searching for [logincheck(user);].

proposal.recommended_next_step: Fetch the referenced sysinit.shtml from a test device running the stated firmware to reproduce the disclosure and identify the root cause; if confirmed, remove sensitive credentials from client-side code and release updated firmware that stores secrets only server-side.
